trap.label: into account
trap.wrong: The panel took in account the formal reply.
trap.right: The panel took into account the formal reply.
trap.why: Em português “levar em conta” usa em. O aluno escreve in. Em inglês, take into account.

mcq.q: “It is high time the board ___ the plan.”

fix.wrong: Would you care dine with us?
fix.right: Would you care to dine with us?

fix.right: Had I known, I would have called.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva de forma formal: “Wanna grab a bite?”
Reescreva com take into account: “We consider the delay.”
rewrite.answer: We take the delay into account.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com It is high time: “We must go now.”
rewrite.answer: It is high time we went.
